comment: Dr. Seman's passion for caudillismo and populism in Latin America is palpable through his lectures. He genuinely welcomed our criticism and feedback of the course. He also invited us to his house at the end of the semester to present our final projects and cooked empanadas for us. Great professor and easy, manageable readings!
Interesting class with good lectures but very reading heavy

He will never give a straight answer during the course. The class is very conceptual and abstract, but if you don't agree with the arguments he pulls out of readings, you're wrong. Easier paper grader than tests- they're long essay questions and timed. Definitely would not recommend because he was very confusing and didn't really learn anything.

There are virtually no grades for the class-the midterm, final paper, and final exam. There are quizzes on the readings but he gives them back with corrections but no grades. There were a lot of readings assigned and they were all really random. Not sure what I learned from this course.
